acceptance: The client-page spec passes on the dev stack and in portal-e2e CI, run ids in evidence.
forge new scaffolds a server page and a client page; both serve on first push.
author: rory
statement: A real interactive client page is proven end to end, and the customer starter offers both modes — Extend forge-portal-e2e with a client page that holds state, handles a click, calls an op over REST and renders the result; extend forge new's TSX starter (TSX-17) with a client page beside the server page. The record is forge-platform-architecture ADR-0039 (decisions 7a, 8, 9), which supersedes ADR-0038 decision 7's 'no JavaScript' paragraph.
